q: Chaos in the sense of positive topological entropy is implied by the existence of a transverse homoclinic point. The Smale-Birkhoff theorem states:
opts: Transverse homoclinic points imply a periodic orbit
A transverse homoclinic point implies a hyperbolic invariant set homeomorphic to the full shift (a horseshoe)
Homoclinic tangencies always lead to chaos
exp: Smale-Birkhoff: near a transverse homoclinic point (stable and unstable manifolds of a hyperbolic periodic orbit meet transversally), there is a horseshoe—an invariant set conjugate to the shift. This gives positive topological entropy and countably many periodic orbits.
